ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a large rectangle, divided into four congruent small rectangles. On the left side and the right side there is each one vertically placed small rectangle, and they both extend from the upper side of the large rectangle to the lower side; in the middle part there are two horizontally placed small rectangles, stacked one above the other, with a horizontal dividing line in the middle. Reasoning: Let the short side of each small rectangle be 10 cm, and the long side be x cm. The height of the left and right two vertically placed small rectangles is the height of the large rectangle, therefore the height of the large rectangle is x. The two horizontally placed small rectangles in the middle are stacked one above the other, and the vertical height of each horizontally placed small rectangle is the short side 10 cm, so the height of the large rectangle is also 10 + 10 = 20 cm. Therefore x = 20 cm. The horizontal long side of the large rectangle is composed of the width 10 cm of the left vertically placed small rectangle, the length x = 20 cm of the middle horizontally placed small rectangle, and the width 10 cm of the right vertically placed small rectangle, so the length is 10 + 20 + 10 = 40 cm.
